acceptanceCriteria: Measure writer-checkpoint decode time and size at 3k/6k/13k receipts (synthetic stores via TestRC3_SyntheticStore) separately from the receipts/ listings, with load recorded.

If history-proportional: bound retained request records or decode cost without changing lease/fencing semantics, with a test and one mutation; otherwise record the measurement as refuting the suspicion.
body: Residual from the V1-0887/V1-1403 heartbeat lane (PR #920, branch claude/tasks-heartbeat-o1-0887-1403, head 308b06a1e, base 55b0c0f09; darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores, load 35-39). The fast lease route (CAL-V0-232) reads no receipt history, but decoding the writer checkpoint hashes the body and copies retained request records whose count grows with history (internal/tasks/journal/writer_checkpoint.go:201/239, advancement at :323). Measured heartbeat CPU 460 ms at 3k receipts vs 490 ms at 13k; ~31 ms of the ~48 ms delta is the two receipts/ listings, ~17 ms unattributed and suspected to include this decode. Expected: checkpoint decode independent of history. Actual: unquantified, suspected history-proportional.
title: corvint-tasks: writer-checkpoint decode cost grows with journal history on every fast lease write
